text_blocks.snippet: Blood pressure can rise due to a variety of factors, including lifestyle choices, underlying health conditions, and even temporary stress. Common causes include unhealthy eating habits, lack of physical activity, and excessive alcohol consumption. Stress can also cause temporary increases in blood pressure due to the release of hormones that speed up the heart and narrow blood vessels.
